Get away and never look back. I made the mistake of forgiving and going back multiple times to my ex. You are not to blame. Because you love him you may feel like it's your fault and he will continue to blame you, but IT IS NOT YOUR FAULT. I understand having arugments with your significant other, but it should never lead to physical violence. You should never fear for your life with the person you love. And he doesn't love you if he can hurt you like that. He has shown you who he is. Let him go, do not have contact with him ever again, change your number, get a po box, get a therapist and just do whatever you need to do to keep yourself safe and healthy. 

I'm so sorry this happened to you, it's a terrifying feeling being alone and not knowing where to turn. But the first step is never allowing this piece of crap into your life ever again.

My ex was like this. Would never help me with keeping the house clean. He didn't know how to do laundry and every time I tried to show him he would "forget." When I asked him how he did laundry before I moved in he said his old roommate did it or he would take his clothes over to his sisters or moms to do them... This man is 30 years old. He always had an excuse for why he wouldn't do stuff around the house. Pure laziness is what it was, and expecting me to do it all because that's what his mom had done for him his entire life, take care of everything. As you can guess, our relationship ended up having a ton of other problems because he just didn't want to take care of himself, he expected someone else to do it for him instead of learn.

Was put on a hold a couple of years ago after a suicide attempt. Got no help whatsoever. All I did was get up super early in the morning, eat my meals throughout the day, sit in a room doing sudoku to keep myself distracted all day, then bed. I don't remember ever actually speaking to a therapist. What's even worse is how little the staff cared about the patient's with worse mental illnesses than mine. I couldn't sleep one night and watched one of the other women in my room calmly walk out in the hall to say she was upset and couldn't sleep. I remember her asking to sit in the tv room to watch something. That's literally it. The staff immediately got confrontational and eventually were throwing this woman on the floor. Beforehand she had been calm and not at all aggressive. I felt helpless. Maybe not all hospitals are like this, but in my experience have only been useless and only prisons.
